title: Casper and the Language
author: Orsen Okonkwo
blurb: Xanthe Thackeray, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
